svg.title: Decision rights on one real decision: who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed
svg.desc: Three bodies: the board or its audit and risk committee oversees; the executive steering committee prioritizes, funds, and owns exceptions above the CISO's authority; technical bodies such as a change advisory board apply the standards. For an internet-facing system that cannot be patched before a release freeze, the system owner is accountable, the platform team is responsible for compensating controls, security and legal are consulted, and the steering committee is informed through the exception register.
